records.scope: Flask application implementing the flightaware.com mirror: live tracker surface, airport activity boards (arrivals/departures/enroute/scheduled, login-gated exactly like upstream), flight detail and history pages, Flight Finder, fleet and aircraft-type browsers, worldwide delays, MiseryMap, cancellation statistics, aviation photo community, Squawks headlines, and the authenticated account area with flight status alerts. Route patterns and page structure follow the upstream site.

Deterministic build-time and boot-time seeder. All content rows come from the tracked _seed_*.py snapshots; benchmark users use a frozen bcrypt hash so the SQLite seed is byte-reproducible on every build.

16 major airports captured from live /live/airport/<code> pages and /resources/airport/<code>/weather + remarks pages on 2026-09-22 (names, cities, regions, timezone labels, current conditions and temperatures, FAA A/FD remarks tables), plus 379 airports referenced by the activity boards with the exact name+code labels the boards display.

1,262 rows captured verbatim from the inline ARRIVALS / DEPARTURES / EN ROUTE-SCHEDULED ARRIVALS / SCHEDULED DEPARTURES boards of 16 airports on 2026-09-22 (idents, aircraft type codes, origin/destination labels, displayed times in their local timezone labels, board order).

1,228 dated flight instances from the airport boards plus 498 historical/upcoming rows captured from live flight detail and history pages on 2026-09-22: origin/destination, displayed times, gates and terminals, status lines, filed routes, speeds and altitudes for the 75 detail-enriched idents, and per-ident multi-day schedules.
136 airline codes observed on the boards with their public ICAO/IATA identities and names (cross-checked against the airline lines shown on the flight detail pages).
76 aircraft type codes observed on the boards with their public type names (cross-checked against the 'Aircraft Type' lines shown on the flight detail pages).

79 aviation photo records captured from flightaware.com photo pages on 2026-09-22: titles, aircraft types, registrations, photographers, vote counts and averages, view counts, submission ages, photo descriptions, ranking sequences and viewer comments.
14 Squawks captured from the flightaware.com squawk lists on 2026-09-22: titles, summaries, source domains, submitters, vote counts and member comment counts.

Worldwide airport delay entries, the four daily delay/cancellation totals and the 283-row by-airline / by-origin / by-destination cancellation tables captured from /live/airport/delays/ and /live/cancelled/ on 2026-09-22.
79 real aviation photos downloaded from photos.flightaware.com retriever URLs on 2026-09-22; each file's byte length and SHA-256 are pinned in asset_inventory.json together with its source URL.
4 map renders captured from the live flightaware.com map elements on 2026-09-22 (live tracker, worldwide delays, JFK area, MiseryMap); source pages recorded in asset_inventory.json.
FlightAware header logos, favicon and homepage hero backgrounds downloaded from flightaware.com image URLs on 2026-09-22.

28 Jinja2 templates reproducing the classic FlightAware page structure: utility bar, search header with dropdown, six-section nav menus, board tables, flight detail layout, photo gallery, squawk cards and footer, styled with the site palette captured from the upstream CSS (header gradient #267BAE→#3A5F97, accent #ED8000, link #3860be).
30 contributor tasks across flight detail, login-gated boards, history, delays/cancellations, MiseryMap, photos, squawks, fleet/type browsing, flight finder and account alert CRUD; no answer keys.
